user_decisions.scope: Overrides the generic fresh-HD-master/A-pose prerequisite; retains original creation failure as history.

limitations: Standing pose rather than open A-pose; inspect arm clearance in returned mesh.
Five native angles include a rear-quarter, not an opposite profile. Use single-image geometry and additional views for manual correction.

Walking.decision: Use heavy alternating foot plant and body sway; remove translation and fit measured stride.

Attack.decision: Author native left rising strike with torso recoil; stored Mutant Punch is a right horizontal swing and is only a deformation stress reference.

Death.decision: Use backward fall and supine final pose; compress long lead-in and match native raised arms.

Hit.decision: Author brief backward recoil with both fists raised; generic Hit Reaction is a mismatched guarding stance.

Standing/Fidget.decision: Author low amplitude rock/shoulder shifting with closed fists.

corrections.diagnosis: Likely loss of identity during service A-pose conversion. Retry identical HD source with pose conversion disabled; fit arms locally if necessary.

corrections.note: Restored native slit face, squared shoulders and closed fists. Smaller stone fissures intentionally left to texture and normal maps.

corrections.diagnosis: Blender portable KHR_materials_specular is unsupported by the engine. Remove that extension only from runtime exports; the explicit ORM red-channel specular mask preserves matte stone.

corrections.user_finding: Walking bulges the upper back and shoulders relative to other actions.
corrections.cause: Retargeted Mutant Walking retains a fixed 24–30 degree torso lean and roughly 25–35 degree clavicle bias; neck/head counter-rotation holds the gaze up.
corrections.change: Removed the average local pose offset from spine, clavicles, neck and head; preserved cyclic motion and all leg/root/arm curves.
corrections.verification: 173 dense samples: feet identical; upper-body p99 edge stretch reduced 1.7745 to 1.2822. Portable parity, all 21 viewer combinations, normal/quarter playback, native walking capture and focused family regression pass. All GLB bytes except seven Walking rotation tracks unchanged.

geometry.repairs: Removed nine overlapping faces at three nonmanifold junctions; capped broken fist/sole/skull/back surfaces without changing original vertex positions. All edges now manifold. Closed finger shells will move rigidly with the fist.
geometry.remaining: None required for technical delivery; final 5,998-triangle model selected after comparison.

reduction.review: Selected 5,998 triangles after matched pose comparisons; closed skull patch rebuilt. An over-weighted first reduction was rejected for angular legs/torso. Final uniform reduction retains the native rock silhouette.

texture_review.body_texture_v1: Selected: reviewed on all three native tiers, front/profile/back and moving/extreme poses; exact UV correspondence with no interior overlaps.
texture_review.head_texture_v1: Rejected: soft mismatched pattern; own HeadUV layout has 593 overlapping interior pixels at 1K. Head return itself matches geometry and supplied UV exactly.
texture_review.head_texture_v2: Selected: paid result completed; exact UV correspondence, no interior overlaps, complete face and neck coverage, reviewed with body.

selected_textures.head: head_texture_v2
selected_textures.sets: Separate 1K body/head, matte stone ORM, measured glTF +Y normal maps. Native palette curves reused for shared tier ramps.

runtime.texture_layout: Body and head each retain 1K detail; runtime packs both into 2080x1024 atlases, shares base textures and region ramps across three tiers.
